why: The enlarged baseline recovers substantial melody but only 8 of 38 pilot chords. The format audit identifies unpromoted text as a plausible integration failure. Holding melody fixed isolates whether chord OCR and structured conversion recover useful information within the four-experiment budget; timing and musician review remain unresolved.
hypothesis: Some missing chords are legible image text that can be recovered through a separate constrained recognition stage without changing melody transcription.
expected_observation: More than eight correctly matched pilot chords and lower chord edit error, with unchanged melody error; failure to improve would argue that text recognition or symbol interpretation, rather than harmony export alone, is the bottleneck.
